scope: All 330 O4 BONES CSV files (651970 rows), 132 O3 quarter16k/32k BONES CSV files (260788 rows), and five O4 LAFAN40 CSV files (200 rows) independently read. No new rollout. Training: all 166 parts, 33002 collection windows. Read-only review of 8 existing failure windows.
main_conclusion: Fixed5e-5 did not preserve long-run performance. Precision worsened at16k/32k before large coverage loss.96k->132k partially recovered, but final remains badly degraded.
parameter_decay_hypothesis_status: source-supported recipe difference; actual parameter norms and original optimizer weight_decay values were not logged, not an established root cause
